$comment: Copy to .lab-env.json (gitignored) and replace the zero GUIDs. expectedTenantId + expectedSubscriptionId = your personal Default Directory and subscription (resource labs A00-A04, A06-A17). expectedEntraTenantId = the disposable Entra test tenant used only for A05 and any script that creates or changes users, groups, guests, or directory policies; it must differ from expectedTenantId. The lab scripts refuse to run if this file is missing, if the signed-in tenant/subscription does not match, or if the tenant looks corporate (any name, domain, or account containing 'deloitte' or a corporatePatterns entry, or a verified custom domain not listed in allowedCustomDomains). See docs/AUTHORING-INFRA.md.
